title: Items Displayed More Compatibility
description: This mod adds compatibility for some other mods to Items Displayed
body:
Items Displayed More Compatibility is a mod which aims to add compatibility for [Items Displayed](https://modrinth.com/mod/items-displayed) with many other mods.

### Currently finished:
- [Tool Trims Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/tool-trims-mod)

### Planned / WIP:
- [More Armor Trims](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-armor-trims)

### WIP (easy to make):
- Ram (More Armor Trims)
- Myth (More Armor Trims)
- Beast (More Armor Trims)
- Horizon (More Armor Trims)
- Twilight (More Armor Trims)

### WIP (hard to make):
- Fever (More Armor Trims)
- Wraith (More Armor Trims)
- Nihility (More Armor Trims)
- Origin (More Armor Trims)
- Parasite (More Armor Trims)

### WIP (done):
- Storm (More Armor Trims) [HarveyHMB]
- Witness (More Armor Trims) [HarveyHMB]
- Greed (More Armor Trims) [HarveyHMB]

## Helping:
Do you have models, or just want me to do another mod. Make an [issue on the github](https://github.com/HarveyHMB/items_displayed_more_compat/issues).

## Credits:
Models and textures based on those from [Items Displayed](https://modrinth.com/mod/items-displayed).
Models and textures inspired by their respective mods.

## Disclaimer:
This mod is not affiliated nor endorsed by the creators of Items Displayed or any other mods.
